app.map.label: Map of Meijel
app.map.lede: Two centuries of Meijel in one place: slide through the maps from 1815 to today and watch the Peel disappear and the village grow. Tap a pin or a name.
app.map.title: Places with a story
app.people.label: People
app.people.lede: The names that shaped the village — mayors, pioneers, sisters and peat cutters, generation after generation. Tap someone to read their story.
app.people.title: Notable villagers
app.photos.label: Photo archive
app.photos.lede: {albums} albums from the Medelo heritage society's photo gallery, {photos} photographs in all. Tap an album, then a photo to see it large.
app.photos.sub: Thousands of historical photos from Meijel and surroundings.
app.photos.title: Photos from the village
app.protmermeels.label: Pròt mèr Mééls
app.protmermeels.sub: Learn the Meijel dialect — word by word, as a game.
app.schoolbord.label: Schoolboard
app.schoolbord.sub: Films about Meijel on the big screen — and learning Mééls.
app.stamboom.label: Family tree
app.stamboom.sub: Search your family name and follow the line back to the 18th century.
app.stories.label: Stories
app.stories.lede: Films about Meijel — genuine archive footage and stories illustrated with AI. Every scene shows the source it was built from.
app.stories.title: Voices from the past
app.timeline.label: Timeline
app.timeline.sub: From prehistoric hunters to Meijel today — over 700 years at a glance.
app.timeline.title: The history of Meijel
app.traditions.label: Traditions
app.traditions.lede: From stilt-walking carnival to the annual procession — what brings the whole village together, year after year.
app.traditions.sub: Carnival, processions and the festivities of Meijel.
app.traditions.title: The year in festivities
